angle_name: Signed Gram-kernel spectral decomposition of the high-sector prime-increment operator (tiled-window pair-correlation form of the quadratic face)
mechanism: Attack the quadratic-form face. On the dominant high-sector branch, m = p·c with p = P⁺(m) exceeding the height threshold, and μ(m) = −μ(c); so the high prefix is S^high_n(Λ) = −Σ_{c ∈ 𝒞} μ(c)·P_c(n) + (smooth-branch remainder), where P_c(n) counts primes p with pc ≤ X_n = (n+1)²−1 and the height condition, and 𝒞 is the squarefree cofactor range forced by Λ. The windowed energy is then exactly the sign-aware quadratic form Σ_{r<H} S² = ⟨Γ μ, μ⟩ with Gram kernel Γ(c,c′) = Σ_{r<H} P̃_c(N+r) P̃_{c′}(N+r), where P̃ is P after subtracting its Li-smoothed main term; no Cauchy–Schwarz or operator-norm step over c is ever taken — the only recombination over c is exact evaluation of Γ with both signs μ(c)μ(c′) retained. Three-way split of Γ: (i) the Li-smoothed part of the increment operator is separable to any fixed order (rank-few), and each ⟨v_k, μ⟩ = Σ_c μ(c)v_k(c) with v_k smooth gets unconditional PNT/Siegel–Walfisz-strength cancellation — the sign of μ is consumed against smooth vectors, not discarded. (ii) The diagonal Σ_c Σ_r P̃_c(N+r)² is, for fixed c, the mean square of R sampled at the points X_{N+r}/c — and here is the key structural observation: as r runs over a window, consecutive increments TILE the contiguous stretch [X_N/c, X_{N+H}/c] exactly (telescoping), with near-equal spacing h_c ≈ 2N/c; at H ≍ N the stretch is a full dyadic block, so this is not a sparse pinned sample of R but a genuine continuum average, to which unconditional mean-value theorems for ψ(t)−t (zero-free region; Huxley/Ingham zero-density for the short-increment refinement, valid since h_c ≈ 2√(Y/c) ≥ Y^{1/6+ε} for c ≤ N^{1/2−ε}) transfer via a discrete-to-integral lemma. (iii) The signed off-diagonal Σ_{c≠c′} μ(c)μ(c′)Γ(c,c′) has main term given by prime pair-correlation densities whose arithmetic content, expanded in Ramanujan sums, carries conductor weight q^{−2} concentrated at q ≤ (log N)^A; those q-modes collapse to |Σ_c μ(c)·(c_q-twisted smooth)|² terms controlled unconditionally by Siegel–Walfisz — no pair→reduced-denominator combinatorial transfer is ever performed, so the fiber-growth counterexample is not in play. What remains open — and it is the entire residual difficulty — is two-sided average control of the pair-correlation ERROR after subtracting separable + small-conductor main terms; under-RH heuristics and the packet's flat 0.35–0.43 calibration both predict this residual is O(diagonal), exactly what rung 2 needs, but proving it unconditionally is at or near the strength of prime-correlation conjectures. Honest lens boundary: this Hilbert-space mechanism structurally reaches (A) an unconditional exponential-saving energy bound at full window (rung 0), and (B) an exact reduction of rung 2 to [mean-square R at RH strength on the diagonal] + [off-diagonal residual ≤ O(diagonal)]; it does not by itself reach rung 2, and the uniform-in-H requirement of the Lean statement (H = 1 is a pointwise bound) is untouched by any averaging lens — the H ≍ N sector is where this angle lives. All feasibility claims are UNVERIFIED speculation.
new_leverage: (1) Tiling identity: in the quadratic face the window increments of each dilated prime count telescope into an exact partition of one contiguous interval, so at H ≍ N the pinned deterministic samples become a genuine full-dyadic continuum average of R — obstacle 3 is structurally voided for the full-window energy, which no Abel-face pointwise formulation exposes. (2) Sign-aware kernel evaluation replaces completion: the only over-c operation is exact computation of the Gram kernel with μ(c)μ(c′) retained; the F-closed step (operator-norm/CS over c) is identified and never taken, and CS is used only in the r-variable on R-only quantities, outside the audited class. (3) Conductor relocation: the off-diagonal arithmetic enters through a convergent Ramanujan expansion with weight q^{−2} and effective conductors q ≤ (log N)^A, where Siegel–Walfisz operates — replacing the dead pair→modulus fiber transfer (conductors 4D², linear fibers) with an analytic expansion that never leaves log-power conductor level. (4) The identification μ(pc) = −μ(c) inside the high sector shows the quadratic face is natively a bilinear μ×π object, so the sign interaction the F-closure demands is present before any manipulation. All UNVERIFIED speculation until the kill test runs.
target_estimate: Windowed High-sector Gram Estimate (WHGE). Variables: N → ∞; window H ≍ N (full-window sector; the Lean statement's uniform 1 ≤ H ≤ N is NOT claimed); height parameter Λ ≥ 0 fixed; square samples X_n = (n+1)²−1; cofactor range 𝒞 = 𝒞(Λ,N) ⊆ {squarefree c ≤ N^{1/2−ε}} (large-prime branch), smooth branch (c ≫ q_m) estimated separately by de Bruijn Ψ-counts. Statement: with P̃_c(n) the height-restricted count of primes p, pc ≤ X_n, minus its Li-smoothed main term, prove Σ_{r<H} ( Σ_{c∈𝒞} μ(c) P̃_c(N+r) )² ≤ C_ε · H · N^{2+ε}, i.e. ⟨Γμ, μ⟩ ≤ C_ε H N^{2+ε} with Γ(c,c′) = Σ_{r<H} P̃_c(N+r)P̃_{c′}(N+r). Component targets and permitted losses: diagonal Σ_c Γ(c,c) ≪ H N^{2+ε} (needs mean-square R at RH strength for small c — open; the unconditional version gives only H N⁴ exp(−c₀(log N)^{3/5})); separable + small-conductor part ≪ H N² (log N)^{−A} unconditionally via Siegel–Walfisz (ineffective constants accepted); off-diagonal residual required ≤ O(diagonal) — the open two-sided pair-correlation error bound. Trivial scale for this energy: H N⁴ (from |S^high| ≤ X_N ≈ N²); packet empirics sit at ≈ 0.02·H·x, consistent with WHGE.

obstacle_positions.F_closure: Exited by construction: the Mertens input is not Σ M(d)² and there is no completion/large-sieve step; the only recombination over the μ-carrying index c is exact evaluation of the signed Gram kernel ⟨Γμ,μ⟩ with μ(c)μ(c′) retained, after which μ meets only smooth vectors and small-conductor Ramanujan modes (Siegel–Walfisz consumes the sign). Cauchy–Schwarz appears solely in the r-variable on R-only quantities (discrete-to-integral transfer), where no μ recombination occurs. The forbidden step ‖Eμ‖ ≤ ‖E‖_op‖μ‖ is identified and never taken.
obstacle_positions.fiber_growth: Avoided rather than solved: no combinatorial pair→shared-denominator transfer is performed; off-diagonal arithmetic enters via the convergent Ramanujan-sum expansion of correlation densities, conductor weight q^{−2}, effective support q ≤ (log N)^A. The 4D²-conductor, linear-fiber regime never arises. The price: large-conductor content is pushed into the pair-correlation error term, which is my weakest point (see risk).
obstacle_positions.pinned_vs_averaged: Partially structurally voided — the angle's main new claim: window increments telescope into exact tilings of contiguous intervals, and at H ≍ N the tiled stretch is a full dyadic block, so continuum mean-value theorems apply to the pinned deterministic samples with no exceptional-set loophole (modulo a discrete-to-integral lemma to be checked for c near N^{1/2}). NOT voided for small H: the Lean statement's uniformity down to H = 1 is a pointwise bound this lens cannot average away; I explicitly do not claim it.
obstacle_positions.modulus_magnitude: Irrelevant to this mechanism: no wheel modulus is used; the only moduli are Ramanujan-expansion conductors q ≤ (log N)^A, far below both 6x and packet-conductor level. No √(full-modulus) gain is invoked, vacuously or otherwise.
obstacle_positions.parity: Not sieve-only, so the parity wall does not bind: μ enters linearly and its cancellation is harvested from L-function zero-free regions (PNT, Siegel–Walfisz on q-twisted sums), which see parity. Sieves appear only optionally as UPPER bounds on off-diagonal prime-pair counts, where parity does not obstruct; I flag plainly that signed two-sided control of the residual cannot come from sieves alone.
obstacle_positions.circularity: R appears only through (a) window-averaged second moments over full dyadic tilings, bounded by unconditional zero-free-region / zero-density mean-value theorems — never pointwise R(t) ≪ t^{1/2+ε}; (b) the c = 1 (d = 1) term sits inside the diagonal mean square, where unconditional bounds give only exponential savings — exactly why the rung-2 form of WHGE is declared a REDUCTION (to mean-square-RH strength on the diagonal), not claimed unconditionally. No RH-strength pointwise prime bound is used anywhere.
obstacle_positions.finite_range: The flat 0.35–0.43 calibration is consistent with my prediction (off-diagonal residual = O(diagonal)) but is treated strictly as kill-only evidence, per the Mertens precedent. Siegel–Walfisz makes my constants ineffective — a failure mode numerics can never detect — and the pair-correlation residual could turn on at log scale exactly as M(x)/√x does; the kill test is therefore designed to falsify structure (rank-few + small-conductor sufficiency), not to confirm magnitude.

kill_test: Cheapest kill (about one day of compute, within the project's existing ≤10⁹ numerics range): fix N ≈ 10⁴ (x ≈ 10⁸), H = N, Λ per repo convention, squarefree cofactors c ≤ 100. Compute the empirical kernel Γ(c,c′) from prime tables; subtract (a) the best rank-3 separable approximation and (b) Ramanujan/small-conductor modes with q ≤ 30. Compare |Σ_{c≠c′} μ(c)μ(c′) Γ_residual(c,c′)| against Σ_c Γ(c,c). KILL CONDITIONS: (1) residual signed off-diagonal ≳ diagonal (no decorrelation — the central hope is false); (2) the subtracted main terms capture < 90% of off-diagonal mass (kernel not rank-few + small-conductor structured); (3) the discrete-to-integral tiling transfer fails empirically for c near the top of range (sample mean square of R at tiling points off by more than a bounded factor from the integral mean square over the same stretch). Any one kills the angle at rung ≥ 1; none of them, per obstacle 7, proves anything.
rung0_plan: Unconditional, bounded effort (weeks): prove the exponential-saving full-window energy bound. Choose Λ so the large-prime branch has cofactors c ≤ exp((log N)^{3/5}); bound the smooth branch by Ψ(X,·) counts (de Bruijn, power-small). Diagonal: for each c, the tiling identity plus the unconditional Vinogradov–Korobov mean value ∫_Y^{2Y}(ψ(t)−t)² dt ≪ Y³ exp(−c₀(log Y)^{3/5}) gives Σ_r P̃_c² ≪ (N⁴/c²) exp(−c₀(log N)^{3/5}) after a discrete-to-integral lemma (the one genuinely new lemma; CS only in r). Off-diagonal at this rung: crude triangle over c-pairs costs a factor absorbed by the shortened c-range. Result: Σ_{r<N} |S^high_{N+r}(Λ)|² ≪ N⁵ exp(−c₁(log N)^{3/5−ε}), which is o(trivial N⁵); pushed through the kernel-equivalence to the Abel face in averaged form, this is an unconditional PNT-strength bound on the windowed mean square of the Abel sum — rung 0 in the energy metric, with effective constants (Siegel–Walfisz not needed at this rung). Publishable-scale but modest; I claim no more for it.
plausible_partial: Named: Unconditional High-sector Energy Theorem (UHET) — for Λ ≥ Λ₀ with cofactor support c ≤ exp((log N)^{3/5}): Σ_{r<N} |S^high_{N+r}(Λ)|² ≪ N⁵ exp(−c₁(log N)^{3/5−ε}), fully unconditional and effective (the rung-0 plan; the discrete-to-integral tiling lemma is its only new technical content). Second, at moderate extra effort: the Structural Reduction Theorem — ProjectedRenewalQuadraticBoundedStatement restricted to H ≍ N follows from [D] mean-square R at RH strength on dyadic blocks plus [O] off-diagonal pair-correlation residual ≤ O(diagonal); a clean two-hypothesis factorization of the rung-2 target isolating exactly which AVERAGED (not pointwise) prime statements suffice, formalizable against the existing Lean interfaces in /mnt/d/Projects/mobius-synthesis/RHLean/Proof/CanonicalGapAncestryQuadraticClosure.lean. Both effort claims are UNVERIFIED speculation; neither is rung 2.
self_assessed_risk: Weakest assumption, stated plainly: that the off-diagonal pair-correlation ERROR — what remains of Γ(c,c′) after removing separable and small-conductor main terms — admits two-sided average control at O(diagonal) strength by unconditional technology. This is unproven, is the sole content between the Structural Reduction Theorem and rung 2, and is plausibly as hard as strong prime-correlation conjectures; if so, the angle caps permanently at rung 0/1 plus the reduction. Secondary risks: (1) the discrete-to-integral tiling lemma may lose a power for c near N^{1/2}, silently reintroducing obstacle 3; (2) the Lean target's uniformity down to H = 1 is pointwise-strength and untouched by this entire lens — even total success in the H ≍ N sector does not discharge the formal statement as written; (3) Siegel ineffectivity contaminates any final constant. Overall: high confidence in rung 0 (UHET), moderate confidence in the two-hypothesis reduction, low confidence (under 10%) that this lens contributes directly to rung 2. If the panel needs a lens that could reach the uniform-in-H statement, mine is not it; my strongest defensible contribution is the tiling observation plus the reduction, marked as adjacent to the full target.
